name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)

ministry.name: Ministry of Women and Child Development
ministry.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development

overview: A national campaign to address the declining child sex ratio and promote the survival, protection and education of the girl child, implemented as part of Mission Shakti.
objectives: Ensure survival and protection of the girl child
Ensure education and empowerment of girl children

benefits.title: Awareness Campaigns
benefits.description: Community mobilisation and multi-sectoral action for girl child welfare

benefits.title: Convergence with Education Schemes
benefits.description: Linkage with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana and other schemes for girl children

otherCriteria: Girl children across India; low child-sex-ratio districts get priority focus

applicationProcess.description: Beneficiary awareness through Anganwadi and district campaigns
Access convergent benefits under BBBP linked schemes

faqs.question: Is BBBP a direct cash transfer scheme?
faqs.answer: No, BBBP is primarily an awareness and convergence campaign, not a DBT scheme.

faqs.question: Which ministry implements BBBP?
faqs.answer: Ministry of Women and Child Development, as part of Mission Shakti.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Women and Child Development
ministry.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development

overview: A maternity benefit programme providing cash incentives to pregnant women and lactating mothers to compensate for wage loss and encourage adequate rest and nutrition.
objectives: Provide partial wage compensation for pregnant/lactating women

benefits.title: Cash Incentive
benefits.description: Cash benefit disbursed in installments to eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers

otherCriteria: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child (with certain exceptions)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)

ministry.name: Ministry of Finance
ministry.department: Department of Economic Affairs / National Savings Institute

overview: A small savings scheme for the girl child, encouraging parents to build a fund for a girl child's future education and marriage expenses, offering attractive interest and tax benefits.
objectives: Encourage savings for the girl child's future
Provide financial security for girl children's education and marriage

benefits.title: Tax Benefits
benefits.description: Deposits eligible for deduction under Section 80C; interest and maturity amount tax-free

otherCriteria: Account can be opened for a girl child below 10 years of age by parent/legal guardian

requiredDocuments.name: Identity and Address Proof of Guardian

applicationProcess.description: Visit any authorised bank or post office
Open account with minimum deposit of Rs. 250
Make periodic deposits until 15 years from account opening
Account matures after 21 years or on marriage after 18 years

faqs.question: What is the minimum and maximum deposit?
faqs.answer: Minimum Rs. 250 and maximum Rs. 1,50,000 per financial year.

faqs.question: When does the account mature?
faqs.answer: 21 years from date of opening, or upon marriage of the girl after age 18.

name: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0

ministry.name: Ministry of Women and Child Development
ministry.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development

overview: An integrated nutrition support programme covering the Anganwadi Services, supplementary nutrition and the POSHAN Abhiyaan to address malnutrition among children, adolescent girls, pregnant women and lactating mothers.
objectives: Reduce malnutrition, stunting and wasting among children
Improve nutritional status of adolescent girls, pregnant and lactating women

benefits.title: Supplementary Nutrition
benefits.description: Take-home ration and hot cooked meals for children and pregnant/lactating women

benefits.title: Growth Monitoring
benefits.description: Regular health and nutrition monitoring through Anganwadi centres

otherCriteria: Children up to 6 years, adolescent girls, pregnant women and lactating mothers

customQuestions.question: Is the beneficiary a child aged 6 months to below 6 years?
Is the beneficiary a pregnant woman?
Is the beneficiary a lactating mother?
Is the beneficiary an adolescent girl aged 14ΓÇô18 years?
Is the child within the 3ΓÇô6 year age group and eligible for Anganwadi early childhood care and pre-school education?
Is the beneficiary registered at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC)?
Does the beneficiary have Aadhaar identification for registration?

applicationProcess.description: Avail supplementary nutrition and health services
Periodic growth monitoring and referral if required

faqs.question: Who benefits from Poshan 2.0?
faqs.answer: Children under 6, adolescent girls, pregnant women and lactating mothers.

faqs.question: What services are provided?
faqs.answer: Nutrition, immunisation referral, health check-ups and pre-school education.

name: Mission Shakti

ministry.name: Ministry of Women and Child Development
ministry.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development

overview: An umbrella scheme for the safety, security and empowerment of women, comprising Sambal (safety and security) and Samarthya (empowerment) sub-schemes.
objectives: Ensure safety and security of women
Promote economic and social empowerment of women
Provide institutional support through One Stop Centres and helplines

benefits.title: One Stop Centre Support
benefits.description: Integrated support for women affected by violence, including medical, legal and counselling aid

benefits.title: Women Helpline
benefits.description: 24x7 emergency response support via helpline number 181

otherCriteria: All women, with focused support for those in distress or requiring safety assistance

customQuestions.question: Are you a woman or girl seeking support under a Mission Shakti component?
Are you a woman/girl who is affected by violence, in distress, or in need of protection/support?
Do you require assistance from a One Stop Centre (OSC) because of violence or distress?
Do you require assistance through the Women Helpline (181)?
Are you seeking legal assistance/dispute resolution through a Nari Adalat?
Are you a woman requiring shelter, rehabilitation or support because of destitution, trafficking or another vulnerable situation?
Are you a working woman who requires safe and conveniently located accommodation?
Are you a pregnant woman or lactating mother who meets the PMMVY conditions?
Are you a woman seeking information about Central/State government schemes and services for women?
Are you a woman requiring childcare/creche services so that you can work or pursue an eligible activity?

applicationProcess.description: Contact nearest One Stop Centre or Women Helpline (181)
Receive medical, legal, police and counselling assistance

faqs.question: What is covered under Mission Shakti?
faqs.answer: Two sub-schemes: Sambal for safety/security and Samarthya for empowerment.

faqs.question: How can a woman in distress get help?
faqs.answer: By calling the Women Helpline number 181 or visiting a One Stop Centre.
